kind: Actual native Page logic, isolated wx/request/Canvas bridge mocks; no network or uploads

checks.name: only own identity and runner APIs are requested; default lifetime PB produces 1080px PNG
results over twenty retain every row and expose all three pages for individual saving
year filter, selection clear/all and PB mode use lifetime records rather than selected year
theme/quote and all four privacy flags reach the generated model with hidden values removed
failed Canvas export has a clear retry and no bogus image path
rapid generation is serialized and only the last style wins
late native PNG callback is discarded and unlinked after settings changed
album authorization is requested only on explicit save; denied scope never repeats prompts
first save denial and storage failure are recoverable without claiming success
preview opens the actual local PNG without uploads or a fabricated URL
hide/unload delete sensitive temporary PNG; show regenerates, unload cannot resurface it
account switch immediately clears old PNG before preview/save and ignores old responses
empty and invalid records create an intentional zero-state; guests never request private APIs
existing entry handlers permit only the current runner and personal member profile
